name: Signed regulatory network
description: Signed regulatory network table used as a structural simulator input. Each row defines one regulator-target effect.
example:
target	regulator	effect
G2	G1	1.2
G3	G1	-0.8
G4	G2	0.6
validation_notes: The target and regulator columns contain simulator gene identifiers.
The effect column must be numeric.
The sign of effect represents activation or repression in the simulator GRN.
